thread:
devin: Nightly eval spike: long-context test set shows consistent instruction loss starting ~18k tokens, baseline (last week) runs fine. Outputs repeat last token and then truncate instructions.
maya: ugh, can you paste an example generation? is it deterministic or only on quantized builds?
devin: quick snippet from the eval run (trimmed):
```
PROMPT: <system>You are an assistant...</system> + 18_500 token user history
GEN: ...processing...
<INSTR> do X </INSTR>
...REPEAT: '>' '>' '>' ... then stops
=== END ===
LOG: kv_index=18497 kv_slot=4096 seqnum=18497
WARNING: prefix_evicted=true
```
maya: hmm prefix_evicted true around 18.5k looks suspicious, could be our KV slot wrap/anchor logic.
liam: FYI I saw a similar trace in a private bring-up last month — we had an off-by-one when computing anchor_offset on session restore. Might be related to the new session-anchor change in runtime v2.4.2.
arun: tagging ci-bot to re-run the nightly with full debug logging on the failing seed @ci-bot
ci-bot: nightly-eval job 1951203333-debug started — https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/1951203333 (logs will appear here)
devin: quick diff between fp16 and int8 quant runs: int8 shows the instruction loss every time; fp16 sometimes recovers. Quantization might be exposing timing of prefix eviction.
maya: can you dump the KV metadata (anchor_offset, wrap_count, active_slots) for the failing run? even a few lines would help.
devin: pasted KV metadata to the job logs (link above). snippet: 
`anchor_offset=18497, anchor_age=0, wrap_count=4, active_slots=4095` — anchor_offset equals seqnum which seems wrong.
liam: that suggests we forgot to roll the anchor when the session compacted. If anchor_offset points at the newest seqnum, subsequent prefix lookups will miss earlier tokens -> lost instructions.
arun: minimal repro idea: run a fake session that alternates append+compact until seqnum ~ 20k and then inject an instruction token and check retrieval. I'll try now.
maya: also run with kernel debug flag KERNEL_KV_WRAP=1 to get the exact eviction trace (helps confirm wrap vs eviction). this is cheap to flip.
devin: note: customer-facing nightly failing prompts are mostly instruction-following tasks; regression rate jumped from 0.4% -> 3.8% on longctx set.
liam: priority: patch anchor roll in runtime, add unit test for anchor_offset after compaction, and add nightly monitor check for anchor_offset > seqnum threshold.
arun: starting patch branch: runtime/kv-anchor-fix, will push small test and bench. tagging @maya for eval-side tests.
maya: thanks. I'll queue a targeted eval run across the longctx suite and include quantized variants. will report back in this thread with pass/fail counts.
devin: if anyone hits the CI link, the debug job saves the offending generations under /artifacts/anchors/1951203333/failing_examples.json
liam: also add a temporary alert if prefix_evicted=true AND anchor_offset >= seqnum-128 — low noise but catches regression early.
maya: noted. I'll update the optimize playbook after confirm. :thumbsup:
arun: pushed preliminary fix, draft PR at https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412 (WIP). please review when able.
devin: running local repro now. will paste results before EOD.
maya: appreciate the quick triage — major win if anchor roll is the root cause.
ci-bot: nightly-eval job 1951203333-debug completed: failures 12/320 (details in artifacts)
liam: good data. let's regroup after the CI run with patched runtime. thanks team.
